candidates.summary: Sundar Pichai posted Alphabet's Q3 results: a half-trillion-dollar annual revenue run rate, revenue growing 25%, and Google Cloud revenue up 103% on AI infrastructure and AI solutions demand.
facts: Pichai: Alphabet is on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with revenues growing 25%.
Pichai: Search YoY query growth rate is the highest in the last five years, including commercial queries, which he attributes to AI investments.
Pichai: Google Cloud revenue grew 103%.
Pichai: Google's first-party model APIs now process nearly 32B tokens per minute, up 40% QoQ.
Pichai names Gemini Argon and Carbon and the Genie 4 world model as model momentum.

candidates.summary: Satya Nadella posted Microsoft's quarterly highlights: Microsoft Cloud revenue passed $63B with growth accelerating to 30% YoY, Foundry revenue more than tripled, and over 50M agents now run in Agent 365.
facts: Nadella: Microsoft Cloud revenue surpassed $63B, growth accelerating to 30% YoY.
Nadella: Copilot daily users grew nearly 50% QoQ and more than 5X YoY; customers with more than 50K Copilot seats up 8X YoY.
Nadella: Foundry revenue more than tripled YoY; customers building with multiple models grew 5X; revenue from open source models increased 10X YoY.
Nadella: over 50M agents are now in A365 (Agent 365), up 30% QoQ; OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude Code and Meta Muse are adopting Windows + Agent 365 on-device boundaries (MXC).
Nadella: with Perception, Microsoft enforces identity, permissions, monitoring and containment outside the model itself.
Nadella: nearly 60K customers access context across Microsoft IQ, up 25% QoQ.

candidates.summary: Vercel launched Vercel CI in beta on all plans: it runs only the tasks a change affects (via Turborepo), gives each task its own machine, and lets agents inspect, trigger and read CI through the Vercel CLI and MCP.
facts: Vercel: time from git push to CI passed is 2-6x faster in its internal repositories.
Vercel: reads turbo.json; tagging a task with "tags": ["ci"] is enough to start; no workflow YAML; Remote Cache on by default.
Vercel: setup prompt for coding agents uses `npx skills use vercel/ci@setup`.
CLI commands include vc ci ls, vc ci inspect, vc ci logs.
Vercel post: after nearly 8 million tasks; in beta on all plans.

candidates.summary: Kun Chen argues CI is the next bottleneck once teams stop reviewing most agent code, and lists three fixes: move checks from CI to CD, modularize so CI runs only touched modules, and invest in test selection.
facts: Kun Chen: skipping most mac and windows tests in CI (Linux covered the same functionality) made his CI pipeline 15x faster, at the cost of occasionally catching OS-only bugs in CD.
Kun Chen: a nightly loop audits past test runs and tunes test selection; on a big codebase that gave 20x faster CI than running all tests, "and almost never miss any real problem".

candidates.summary: Vercel added Virtual Models to AI Gateway: one model ID per agent task whose underlying model, fallbacks and Zero Data Retention setting are changed centrally, with no code change or redeploy.
facts: Vercel: 125 new models from more than 10 labs became available on AI Gateway in the last 90 days, about 10 a week.
Example: `vercel ai-gateway virtual-models create coding-agent --model anthropic/claude-opus-5.5`, then call model 'vmc/coding-agent'; apps pick up an edited model within a few minutes.
Works with coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex via `vercel ai-gateway setup`.

candidates.summary: Suhail announced Particle, a new inference company for open-weight models; its first model, particle-1, keeps performance parity while using about 45% fewer tokens, per the founder.
facts: Suhail: particle-1 focused on token efficiency, "managed to keep parity in performance while using ~45% fewer tokens" (no benchmark named in the post).
Particle site: an AI inference layer for open weight models, offered as an API.

Aravind Srinivas says Perplexity worked with Particle ahead of launch and plans to work with it on search and model orchestration; Vercel's Guillermo Rauch says Particle models will be served via Vercel AI Gateway.

candidates.summary: An a16z survey of 100 CISOs at companies with 1,000+ employees finds 55% already run MCPs or agent-to-app integrations in production and 34% run autonomous agents with tool access or write permissions.
facts: In production: employee generative AI tools 92%, AI coding assistants or agents 83%, MCPs or agent-to-app integrations 55%, autonomous agents with tool access or write permissions 34%.
Top concerns: AI attacks outpacing their team 55%, employees leaking data into AI tools 47%, AI agents exceeding permissions or getting compromised 46%.
a16z: 18% of CISOs run most offensive testing continuously today, 52% expect to within a year; 70% would use AI to retest and confirm fixes.

candidates.summary: Surge AI released DAYJOB: Tax, 50 expert-built tax assignments (1,789 files) testing whether agents can take a client request to a finished deliverable; the best model passes 10.8%.
facts: Leaderboard (pass@1 at a 95% rubric threshold): Claude Sonnet 5.5 10.8%, Claude Fable 5.1 9.6%, Claude Opus 5.5 9.2%.
Workspaces: 1,789 files, median 30 per assignment, up to 123; 1,487 PDFs, 117 Excel workbooks, 38 Word documents, plus emails, images and CSVs.
Eight areas, from individual tax to international tax and disputes; each task gets a three-layer expert review.

Case study: across five attempts Astra never flagged a home-sale exclusion deadline that Opus caught in all five; in another, Opus assumed a couple was unmarried in all five attempts while Astra checked marital status in four of five.

candidates.summary: A researcher crawling 10,000 sites found a fingerprinting script stuffed with fake weapons and self-harm function names and hidden jailbreak text, apparently to make AI models refuse to deobfuscate it; it also tries to read secrets files when run under Node with a specific env flag.
facts: The script was served from servicepipe.tech; its hidden payload was encoded in invisible Unicode tag characters.
Author: Astra refused to deobfuscate it, citing biological safety risks; GLM-5.3 complied with the same prompt.
Under Node with env var METRICS_AGENT_8BFD_ACTIVE set, code targets files including .npmrc, .env, .docker/config.json, .kube/config and .git/config, and tries to download a binary from a private IP.
Crawl used Playwright on the Tranco top-sites list, hooking canvas toDataURL and navigator.webdriver; results published at fingerprint.garden.
